pages.text: As Arachnid you can use webs as easy as you walk, therefor you've learned the skill to use webs in combat. When you hit an enemy they will be webbed in your webs and be stuck until they either get out or when the web disappears.

pages.title: Craftable Cobwebs
pages.text: Not only can you use webs in combat, you can of course craft your own webs. As an arachnid this is a skill one must know when hunting on their own. Without the webs there's no way you can hunt prey. $(br2)  The web can be created by using 2 strings in your crafting table or through player crafting. If you don't know how to craft it, you can look it up in your origins menu by pressing the key: ($(k:origins.view_origin)), here you can find the recipe through the master of webs power.

pages.title: Facts and Tips
pages.text: Some facts: $(li) The cooldown of the power is exactly 6 seconds and is shown right above your hunger bar (If not changed by any other mod). $(li) The cobweb stays in the world for around 3 seconds, you can see when it disappears if you look at your cooldown bar and see that it's exactly at halve the time. $(li) Arthropods are affected by your webs. $(li) The cobweb can not be broken. $(li) You can use your ability to strike hard, due to your less health this is a way to survive. $(li2) If against a mob you can use it to eat, regenerate, flee or finish it off. $(li2) If against a player you can use lava to deal a massive amount of damage, use potions to weaken the player, take distance/flee, eat/regenerate or deal a lot of damage.
